notes.title: Development update #1
notes.content:
[p]Lately i´ve been going to work implementing new features to the game and some new levels. These are all implemented and intended to be included in the full game upon release. [/p][list][*][p]Added Steam achievements - And with that comes new things to collect and find, other than bones[/p][/*][*][p]Cloud saves - I've been looking into adding cloud saves so your saves will remain safe[/p][/*][*][p]A new gameplay biome - Forests are great and all but i've been expanding upon the art of the biomes[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic lighting - As part of the art direction certain levels will have a bit more varied and dynamic lighting[/p][/*][/list][p]Have you been enjoying the demo? Feel free to add any feedback or thoughts in the comments, i'll read every single one of them. 

Regards, 
Mr Sausage[/p]
